features.name: Shackles of Guilt - Reaction: Countdown (Loop 2d6)
features.text: When the Sorcerer is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all targets within Far range become _Vulnerable_ and must mark a Stress as they relive their greatest regrets. A target can break free from their regret with a successful Presence or Strength Roll. When a PC fails to break free, they lose a Hope.

adversaries.name: Fallen Warlord: Realm-Breaker
adversaries.desc: A Fallen God, wreathed in rage and resentment, bearing millennia of experience in breaking heroes' spirits.
adversaries.motives: Corrupt, dominate, punish, break the weak

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Firespite Plate Armor
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by **2d10**.

features.name: Tormenting Lash
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 Armor Slots.

features.name: All-Consuming Rage - Reaction: Countdown (Decreasing 8)
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, create a torrent of incarnate rage that rends flesh from bone. All targets within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d6+10** direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. For each HP marked from this damage, summon a Fallen Shock Troop within Very Close range of the target who marked that HP. If the countdown ever decreases its maximum value to 0, the Realm-Breaker marks their remaining HP and all targets within Far range must mark all remaining HP and make a death move.

features.name: Doombringer
features.text: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Realm-Breaker, all PCs within Far range of the target must lose a Hope.

features.name: I Have Never Known Defeat (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker marks their last HP, replace them with the Undefeated Champion and immediately spotlight them.

adversaries.name: Fallen Warlord: Undefeated Champion
adversaries.desc: That which only the most feared have a chance to fear.
adversaries.motives: Dispatch merciless death, punish the defiant, secure victory at any cost

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Faltering Armor
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by **1d10**.

features.name: Shattering Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.

features.name: Endless Legions
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

features.name: Circle of Defilement - Reaction: Countdown (1d8)
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is _Vulnerable_ until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Doombringer
features.text: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.

adversaries.name: Giant Beastmaster
adversaries.desc: A leather-clad warrior bearing a whip and massive bow.
adversaries.motives: Command, make a living, maneuver, pin down, protect companion animals

features.name: Two as One
features.text: When the Beastmaster is spotlighted, you can also spotlight a Tier 1 animal adversary currently under their control.

features.name: Pinning Strike
features.text: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, you can **mark a Stress** to pin them to a nearby surface. The pinned target is _Restrained_ until they break free with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll.

features.name: Deadly Companion
features.text: Twice per scene, summon a Bear, Dire Wolf, or similar Tier 1 animal adversary under the Beastmaster's control. The adversary appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

adversaries.name: Giant Brawler
adversaries.desc: An especially muscular giant wielding a warhammer larger than a human.
adversaries.motives: Make a living, overwhelm, slam, topple

features.name: Battering Ram
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Brawler charge at an inanimate object within Close range they could feasibly smash (such as a wall, cart, or market stand) and destroy it. All targets within Very Close range of the object must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d4+3** physical damage from the shrapnel.

features.name: Bloody Reprisal
features.text: When the Brawler marks 2 or more HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can make a standard attack against the attacker. On a success, the Brawler deals **2d6+15** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Brawler makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Giant Eagle
adversaries.desc: A giant bird of prey with blood-stained talons.
adversaries.motives: Hunt prey, stay mobile, strike decisively

features.name: Flight
features.text: While flying, the Eagle gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Deadly Dive
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Far range. On a success, deal **2d10+2** physical damage and knock the target over, making them _Vulnerable_ until they next act.

features.name: Take Off- Action
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal **2d4+3** physical damage and the target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or become temporarily _Restrained_ within the Eagle's massive talons. If the target is _Restrained_, the Eagle immediately lifts into the air to Very Far range above the battlefield while holding them.

features.name: Deadly Drop
features.text: While flying, the Eagle can drop a _Restrained_ target they are holding. When dropped, the target is no longer _Restrained_ but starts falling. If their fall isn't prevented during the PCs' next action, the target takes **2d20** physical damage when they land.

adversaries.name: Giant Mosquitoes
adversaries.desc: Dozens of fist-sized mosquitoes, flying together for protection.
adversaries.motives: Fly away, harass, steal blood

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Mosquitoes have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Flying
features.text: While flying, the Mosquitoes have a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bloodsucker
features.text: When the Mosquitoes' attack causes a target to mark HP, you can **mark a Stress** to force the target to mark an additional HP.

adversaries.name: Giant Rat
adversaries.desc: A cat-sized rodent skilled at scavenging and survival.
adversaries.motives: Burrow, hunger, scavenge, wear down

features.name: Minion (3)
features.text: The Rat is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Rat, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Rats within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.minionNote:
Minion._** _A cat-sized rodent skilled at scavenging and survival._
Minion (3) - Passive:_** The Rat is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Rat, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Giant Recruit
adversaries.desc: A giant fighter wearing borrowed armor.
adversaries.motives: Batter, make a living, overwhelm, terrify

features.name: Minion (7)
features.text: The Recruit is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Recruit, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Recruits within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.minionNote:
Minion._** _A giant fighter wearing borrowed armor._
Minion (7) - Passive:_** The Recruit is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Recruit, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Giant Scorpion
adversaries.desc: A human-sized arachnid with tearing claws and a stinging tail.
adversaries.motives: Ambush, feed, grapple, poison

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against two targets within Melee range.

features.name: Venomous Stinger
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, **spend a Fear** to deal **1d4+4** physical damage and _Poison_ them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (16). While _Poisoned_, the target must roll a **d6** before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Scorpion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Glass Snake
adversaries.desc: A clear serpent with a massive head that leaves behind a glass shard trail wherever they go.
adversaries.motives: Climb, feed, keep distance, scare

features.name: Armor-Shredding Shards
features.text: After a successful attack against the Snake within Melee range, the attacker must mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an HP.

features.name: Spinning Serpent
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Snake succeeds against take **1d6+1** physical damage.

features.name: Spitter
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to introduce a **d6** Spitter Die. When the Snake is in the spotlight, roll this die. On a result of 5 or higher, all targets in front of the Snake within Far range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **1d4** physical damage. The Snake can take the spotlight a second time this GM turn.

adversaries.name: Gorgon
adversaries.desc: A snake-headed, scaled humanoid with a gilded bow, enraged that their peace has been disturbed.
adversaries.motives: Corner, hit-and-run, petrify, seek vengeance

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Gorgon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Sunsear Arrows
features.text: When the Gorgon makes a successful standard attack, the target _Glows_ until the end of the scene and can't become _Hidden_. Attack rolls made against a _Glowing_ target have advantage.

features.name: Crown of Serpents
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Melee range using the Gorgon's protective snakes. On a success, **mark a Stress** to deal **2d10+4** physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Petrifying Gaze
features.text: When the Gorgon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can **spend a Fear** to force the attacker to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they begin to turn to stone, marking a HP and starting a Petrification Countdown (4). This countdown ticks down when the Gorgon is attacked. When it triggers, the target must make a death move. If the Gorgon is defeated, all petrification countdowns end.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Gorgon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Greater Earth Elemental
adversaries.desc: A living landslide of boulders and dust, as large as a house.
adversaries.motives: Avalanche, knock over, pummel

features.name: Slow
features.text: When you spotlight the Elemental and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Elemental and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Crushing Blows
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Immovable Object
features.text: An attack that would move the Elemental moves them two fewer ranges (for example, Far becomes Very Close). When the Elemental takes physical damage, reduce it by 7.

features.name: Rockslide
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to create a rockslide that buries the land in front of Elemental within Close range with rockfall. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (19). Targets who fail take **2d12+5** physical damage and become _Vulnerable_ until their next roll with Hope. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Greater Water Elemental
adversaries.desc: A huge living wave that crashes down upon enemies.
adversaries.motives: Deluge, disperse, drown

features.name: Water Jet
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal **2d4+7** physical damage and the target's next action has disadvantage. On a failure, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Drowning Embrace
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against become _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ as they begin drowning. A target can break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll.

features.name: High Tide
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to knock the target back to Close range.

adversaries.name: Green Ooze
adversaries.desc: A moving mound of translucent green slime.
adversaries.motives: Camouflage, consume and multiply, creep up, envelop

features.name: Slow
features.text: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Acidic Form
features.text: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Envelop
features.text: Make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. The target must mark an additional Stress when they make an action roll. If the Ooze takes Severe damage, the target is freed.

features.name: Split
features.text: When the Ooze has 3 or more HP marked, you can **spend a Fear** to split them into two Tiny Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

adversaries.name: Hallowed Archer
adversaries.desc: Spirit soldiers with sanctified bows.
adversaries.motives: Focus fire, obey, reposition, volley

features.name: Punish the Guilty
features.text: The Archer deals double damage to targets marked _Guilty_ by a High Seraph.

features.name: Divine Volley
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against up to three targets.

adversaries.name: Hallowed Soldier
adversaries.desc: Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry.
adversaries.motives: Obey, outmaneuver, punish, swarm

features.name: Minion (13)
features.text: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.text: While the Soldier is flying, **spend a Fear** to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.minionNote:
Minion._** _Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry._
Minion (13) - Passive:_** The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Harrier
adversaries.desc: A nimble fighter armed with javelins.
adversaries.motives: Flank, harry, kite, profit

features.name: Maintain Distance
features.text: After making a standard attack, the Harrier can move anywhere within Far range.

features.name: Fall Back
features.text: When a creature moves into Melee range to make an attack, you can **mark a Stress** before the attack roll to move anywhere within Close range and make an attack against that creature. On a success, deal **1d10+2** physical damage.

adversaries.name: Head Guard
adversaries.desc: A seasoned guard with a mace, a whistle, and a bellowing voice.
adversaries.motives: Arrest, close gates, pin down, seek glory

features.name: Rally Guards
features.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to spotlight the Head Guard and up to **2d4** allies within Far range.

features.name: On My Signal - Reaction: Countdown (5)
features.text: When the Head Guard is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC makes an attack roll. When it triggers, all Archer Guards within Far range make a standard attack with advantage against the nearest target within their range. If any attacks succeed on the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Head Guard makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Head Vampire
adversaries.desc: A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.
adversaries.motives: Create thralls, charm, command, fly, intimidate

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Look into My Eyes
features.text: A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain **1d4** Fear.

features.name: Feed on Followers
features.text: When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: The Hunt Is On
features.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to summon **1d4** Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Lifesuck
features.text: When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a **d8**. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP.

adversaries.name: High Seraph
adversaries.desc: A divine champion, head of a hallowed host of warriors who enforce their god's will.
adversaries.motives: Enforce dogma, fly, pronounce judgment, smite

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Seraph can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.text: While the Seraph is flying, **spend a Fear** to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Judgment
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make a target _Guilty_ in the eyes of the Seraph's god until the Seraph is defeated. While _Guilty_, the target doesn't gain Hope on a result with Hope. When the Seraph succeeds on a standard attack against a _Guilty_ target, they deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage. The Seraph can only mark one target at a time.

features.name: God Rays
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to reflect a sliver of divinity as a searing beam of light that hits up to twenty targets within Very Far range. Targets must make a Presence Reaction Roll, with disadvantage if they are marked _Guilty_. Targets who fail take **4d6+12** magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: We Are One
features.text: Once per scene, **spend a Fear** to spotlight all other adversaries within Far range. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

adversaries.name: Huge Green Ooze
adversaries.desc: A translucent green mound of acid taller than most humans.
adversaries.motives: Camouflage, creep up, envelop, multiply

features.name: Slow
features.text: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Acidic Form
features.text: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Envelop
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze _Envelops_ them and the target must mark 2 Stress. While _Enveloped_, the target must mark an additional Stress every time they make an action roll. When the Ooze takes Severe damage, all _Enveloped_ targets are freed and the condition is cleared.

features.name: Split
features.text: When the Ooze has 4 or more HP marked, you can **spend a Fear** to split them into two Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

adversaries.name: Hydra
adversaries.desc: A quadrupedal scaled beast with multiple long-necked heads, each filled with menacing fangs.
adversaries.motives: Devour, regenerate, terrify

features.name: Many-Headed Menace
features.text: The Hydra begins with three heads and can have up to five. When the Hydra takes Major or greater damage, they lose a head.

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.text: The Hydra can be spotlighted X times per GM turn, where X is the Hydra's number of heads. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Regeneration
features.text: If the Hydra has any marked HP, **spend a Fear** to clear a HP and grow two heads.

features.name: Terrifying Chorus
features.text: All PCs within Far range lose 2 Hope.

features.name: Magical Weakness
features.text: When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become _Dazed_ until the next roll with Fear. While _Dazed_, they can't use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

adversaries.name: Jagged Knife Bandit
adversaries.desc: A cunning criminal in a cloak bearing one of the gang's iconic knives.
adversaries.motives: Escape, profit, steal, throw smoke

features.name: Climber
features.text: The Bandit climbs just as easily as they run.

features.name: From Above
features.text: When the Bandit succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal **1d10+1** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

adversaries.name: Jagged Knife Hexer
adversaries.desc: A staff-wielding bandit in a cloak adorned with magical paraphernalia, using curses to vex their foes.
adversaries.motives: Command, hex, profit

features.name: Curse
features.text: Choose a target within Far range and temporarily _Curse_ them. While the target is _Cursed_, you can **mark a Stress** when that target rolls with Hope to make the roll be with Fear instead.

features.name: Chaotic Flux
features.text: Make an attack against up to three targets within Very Close range. **Mark a Stress** to deal **2d6+3** magic damage to targets the Hexer succeeded against.

adversaries.name: Jagged Knife Kneebreaker
adversaries.desc: An imposing brawler carrying a large club.
adversaries.motives: Grapple, intimidate, profit, steal

features.name: I've Got 'Em
features.text: Creatures _Restrained_ by the Kneebreaker take double damage from attacks by other adversaries.

features.name: Hold Them Down
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes no damage but is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_. The target can break free, clearing both conditions, with a successful Strength Roll or is freed automatically if the Kneebreaker takes Major or greater damage.

adversaries.name: Jagged Knife Lackey
adversaries.desc: A thief with simple clothes and small daggers, eager to prove themselves.
adversaries.motives: Escape, profit, throw smoke

features.name: Minion (3)
features.text: The Lackey is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Lackey, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Jagged Knife Lackeys within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.minionNote:
Minion._** _A thief with simple clothes and small daggers, eager to prove themselves._
Minion (3) - Passive:_** The Lackey is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Lackey, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Jagged Knife Lieutenant
adversaries.desc: A seasoned bandit in quality leathers with a strong voice and cunning eyes.
adversaries.motives: Bully, command, profit, reinforce

features.name: Tactician
features.text: When you spotlight the Lieutenant, **mark a Stress** to also spotlight two allies within Close range.

features.name: More Where That Came From
features.text: Summon three Jagged Knife Lackeys, who appear at Far range.

features.name: Coup de Grace
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against a _Vulnerable_ target within Close range. On a success, deal **2d6+12** physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Lieutenant makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Jagged Knife Shadow
adversaries.desc: A nimble scoundrel bearing a wicked knife and utilizing shadow magic to isolate targets.
adversaries.motives: Ambush, conceal, divide, profit

features.name: Backstab
features.text: When the Shadow succeeds on a standard attack that has advantage, they deal **1d6+6** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Cloaked
features.text: Become _Hidden_ until after the Shadow's next attack. Attacks made while _Hidden_ from this feature have advantage.

adversaries.name: Jagged Knife Sniper
adversaries.desc: A lanky bandit striking from cover with a shortbow.
adversaries.motives: Ambush, hide, profit, reposition

features.name: Unseen Strike
features.text: If the Sniper is _Hidden_ when they make a successful standard attack against a target, they deal **1d10+4** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

adversaries.name: Juvenile Flickerfly
adversaries.desc: A horse-sized insect with iridescent scales and crystalline wings moving faster than the eye can see.
adversaries.motives: Collect shiny things, hunt, swoop

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Peerless Accuracy
features.text: Before the Flickerfly makes an attack, roll a **d6**. On a result of 4 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

features.name: Mind Dance
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

features.name: Hallucinatory Breath - Reaction: Countdown (Loop 1d6)
features.text: When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

adversaries.name: Knight of the Realm
adversaries.desc: A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful steed.
adversaries.motives: Run down, seek glory, show dominance

features.name: Chevalier
features.text: While the Knight is on a mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When they take Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount and lose this benefit until they're next spotlighted.

features.name: Heavily Armored
features.text: When the Knight takes physical damage, reduce it by 3.

features.name: Cavalry Charge
features.text: If the Knight is mounted, move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target. On a success, deal **2d8+4** physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: For the Realm!
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight **1d4+1** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

adversaries.name: Kraken
adversaries.desc: A legendary beast of the sea, bigger than the largest galleon, with sucker-laden tentacles and a terrifying maw.
adversaries.motives: Consume, crush, drown, grapple

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Many Tentacles
features.text: While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

features.name: Grapple and Drown
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, **mark a Stress** to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.

features.name: Boiling Blast
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to spew a line of boiling water at any number of targets in a line up to Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d6+9** physical damage. If a target marks an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Kraken makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Masked Thief
adversaries.desc: A cunning thief with acrobatic skill and a flair for the dramatic.
adversaries.motives: Evade, hide, pilfer, profit

features.name: Quick Hands
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **1d8+2** physical damage and the Thief steals one item or consumable from the target's inventory.

features.name: Escape Plan
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to reveal a snare trap set anywhere on the battlefield by the Thief. All targets within Very Close range of the trap must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (13) or be pulled off their feet and suspended upside down. A target is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll (13).

adversaries.name: Master Assassin
adversaries.desc: A seasoned killer with a threatening voice and a deadly blade.
adversaries.motives: Ambush, get out alive, kill, prepare for all scenarios

features.name: Won't See It Coming
features.text: The Assassin deals direct damage while they're _Hidden_.

features.name: Strike as One
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight a number of other Assassins equal to the Assassin's unmarked Stress.

features.name: The Subtle Blade
features.text: When the Assassin successfully makes a standard attack against a _Vulnerable_ target, you can **spend a Fear** to deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Assassin makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Merchant Baron
adversaries.desc: An accomplished merchant with a large operation under their command.
adversaries.motives: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions

features.name: Everyone Has a Price
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to offer a target a dangerous bargain for something they want or need. If used on a PC, they must make a Presence Reaction Roll (17). On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or take the deal.

features.name: The Best Muscle Money Can Buy
features.text: Once per scene, **mark a Stress** to summon **1d4+1** Tier 1 adversaries, who appear at Far range, to enforce the Baron's will.

adversaries.name: Merchant
adversaries.desc: A finely dressed trader with a keen eye for financial gain.
adversaries.motives: Buy low and sell high, create demand, inflate prices, seek profit

features.name: Preferential Treatment
features.text: A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll against the Merchant gains a discount on purchases. A PC who fails on a Presence Roll against the Merchant must pay more and has disadvantage on future Presence Rolls against the Merchant.

features.name: The Runaround
features.text: When a PC rolls a 14 or lower on a Presence Roll made against the Merchant, they must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Minor Chaos Elemental
adversaries.desc: A coruscating mass of uncontrollable magic.
adversaries.motives: Confound, destabilize, transmogrify

features.name: Arcane Form
features.text: The Elemental is resistant to magic damage.

features.name: Sickening Flux
features.text: **Mark a HP** to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress and become _Vulnerable_ until their next rest or they clear a HP.

features.name: Remake Reality
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to transform the area within Very Close range into a different biome. All targets within this area take **2d6+3** direct magic damage.

features.name: Magical reflection
features.text: When the Elemental takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal an amount of damage to the attacker equal to half the damage they dealt.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Minor Demon
adversaries.desc: A crimson-hued creature from the Circles Below, consumed by rage against all mortals.
adversaries.motives: Act erratically, corral targets, relish pain, torment

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Demon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: All Must Fall
features.text: When a PC rolls a failure with Fear while within Close range of the Demon, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Hellfire
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to rain down hellfire within Far range. All targets within the area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **1d20+3** magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Reaper
features.text: Before rolling damage for the Demon's attack, you can **mark a Stress** to gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to the Demon's current number of marked HP.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Minor Fire Elemental
adversaries.desc: A living flame the size of a large bonfire.
adversaries.motives: Encircle enemies, grow in size, intimidate, start fires

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Elemental can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Scorched Earth
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose a point within Far range. The ground within Very Close range of that point immediately bursts into flames. All creatures within this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d8** magic damage from the flames. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Explosion
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to erupt in a fiery explosion. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against take **1d8** magic damage and are knocked back to Far range.

features.name: Consume Kindling
features.text: Three times per scene, when the Elemental moves onto objects that are highly flammable, consume them to clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Minor Treant
adversaries.desc: An ambulatory sapling rising up to defend their forest.
adversaries.motives: Crush, overwhelm, protect

features.name: Minion (5)
features.text: The Treant is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Treant, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Minor Treants within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Minotaur Wrecker
adversaries.desc: A massive bull-headed firbolg with a quick temper.
adversaries.motives: Consume, gore, navigate, overpower, pursue

features.name: Ramp Up
features.text: You must **spend a Fear** to spotlight the Minotaur. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

features.name: Charging Bull
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to charge through a group within Close range and make an attack against all targets in the Minotaur's path. Targets the Minotaur succeeds against take **2d6+8** physical damage and are knocked back to Very Far range. If a target is knocked into a solid object or another creature, they take an extra **1d6** damage (combine the damage).

features.name: Gore
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range, moving the Minotaur into Melee range of them. On a success, deal **2d8** direct physical damage.

adversaries.name: Monarch
adversaries.desc: The sovereign ruler of a nation, wreathed in the privilege of tradition and wielding unmatched power in their domain.
adversaries.motives: Control vassals, destroy rivals, forge a legacy

features.name: Execute Them!
features.text: **Spend a Fear** per PC in the party to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.

features.name: Crownsguard
features.text: Once per scene, **mark a Stress** to summon six Tier 3 Minions, who appear at Close range to enforce the Monarch's will.

features.name: Casus Belli - Reaction: Long-Term Countdown (8)
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to activate after the Monarch's desire for war is first revealed. When it triggers, the Monarch has a reason to rally the nation to war and the support to act on that reason. You gain **1d4** Fear.

adversaries.name: Mortal Hunter
adversaries.desc: An undead figure wearing a heavy leather coat, with searching eyes and a casually cruel demeanor.
adversaries.motives: Devour, hunt, track

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Deathlock
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to curse a target within Very Close range with a necrotic _Deathlock_ until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a _Deathlocked_ target deal direct damage. The Hunter can only maintain one _Deathlock_ at a time.

features.name: Inevitable Death
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to spotlight **1d4** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Rampage - Reaction: Countdown (Loop 1d6)
features.text: When the Hunter is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take **2d8+2** physical damage.

adversaries.name: Oak Treant
adversaries.desc: A sturdy animate old-growth tree.
adversaries.motives: Hide in plain sight, preserve the forest, root down, swing branches

features.name: Just a Tree
features.text: Before they make their first attack in a fight or after they become _Hidden_, the Treant is indistinguishable from other trees until they next act or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll to identify them.

features.name: Seed Barrage
features.text: **Mark a Stress** and make an attack against up to three targets within Close range, pummeling them with giant acorns. Targets the Treant succeeds against take **2d10+5** physical damage.

features.name: Take Root
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to _Root_ the Treant in place. The Treant is _Restrained_ while _Rooted_, and can end this effect instead of moving while they are spotlighted. While Rooted, the Treant has resistance to physical damage.

adversaries.name: Oracle of Doom
adversaries.desc: A towering immortal and incarnation of fate, cursed to only see bad outcomes.
adversaries.motives: Change environment, condemn, dishearten, toss aside

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Oracle makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Walls Closing In
features.text: When a creature rolls a failure while within Very Far range of the Oracle, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Pronounce Fate
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to present a target within Far range with a vision of their personal nightmare. The target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, they lose all Hope and take **2d20+4** direct magic damage. On a success, they take half damage and lose a Hope.

features.name: Summon Tormentors
features.text: Once per day, **spend 2 Fear** to summon **2d4** Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC's personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.

features.name: Ominous Knowledge
features.text: When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.

features.name: Vengeful Fate
features.text: When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal **2d10+4** physical damage.

adversaries.name: Outer Realms Abomination
adversaries.desc: A chaotic mockery of life, constantly in flux.
adversaries.motives: Demolish, devour, undermine

features.name: Chaotic Form
features.text: When the Abomination attacks, roll **2d4** and use the result as their attack modifier.

features.name: Disorienting Presence
features.text: When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Reality Quake
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become _Unstuck_ from reality until the end of the scene. When an _Unstuck_ target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.

features.name: Unreal Form
features.text: When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by **1d20**. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Outer Realms Corruptor
adversaries.desc: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.
adversaries.motives: Confuse, distract, overwhelm

features.name: Will-Shattering Touch
features.text: When a PC takes damage from the Corruptor, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Disgorge Reality Flotsam
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

adversaries.name: Outer Realms Thrall
adversaries.desc: A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity.
adversaries.motives: Destroy, disgust, disorient, intimidate

features.name: Minion (13)
features.text: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.minionNote:
Minion._** _A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity._
Minion (13) - Passive:_** The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Patchwork Zombie Hulk
adversaries.desc: A towering gestalt of corpses moving as one, with torso-sized limbs and fists as large as a grown halfling.
adversaries.motives: Absorb corpses, flail, hunger, terrify

features.name: Destructible
features.text: When the Zombie takes Major or greater damage, they mark an additional HP.

features.name: Flailing Limbs
features.text: When the Zombie makes a standard attack, they can attack all targets within Very Close range.

features.name: Another for the Pile
features.text: When the Zombie is within Very Close range of a corpse, they can incorporate it into themselves, clearing a HP and a Stress.

features.name: Tormented Screams
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to cause all PCs within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail lose a Hope and you gain a Fear for each. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Perfected Zombie
adversaries.desc: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.
adversaries.motives: Consume, hound, maim, terrify

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Zombie makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Fearsome Presence
features.text: PCs can't spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.

features.name: Perfect Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Zombie succeeds against are _Vulnerable_ until their next rest.

features.name: Skilled Opportunist
features.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Very Close range of the Zombie, you can **spend a Fear** to add the Zombie's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

adversaries.name: Petty Noble
adversaries.desc: A richly dressed and adorned aristocrat brimming with hubris.
adversaries.motives: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions

features.name: My Land, My Rules
features.text: All social actions made against the Noble on their land have disadvantage.

features.name: Guards, Seize Them!
features.text: Once per scene, **mark a Stress** to summon **1d4** Bladed Guards, who appear at Far range to enforce the Noble's will.

features.name: Exile
features.text: **Spend a Fear** and target a PC. The Noble proclaims that the target and their allies are exiled from the noble's territory. While exiled, the target and their allies have disadvantage during social situations within the Noble's domain.

adversaries.name: Pirate Captain
adversaries.desc: A charismatic sea dog with an impressive hat, eager to raid and plunder.
adversaries.motives: Command, make 'em walk the plank, plunder, raid

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.text: When the Captain marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Reinforcements
features.text: Once per scene, **mark a Stress** to summon a Pirate Raiders Horde, which appears at Far range.

features.name: No Quarter
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target who has three or more Pirates within Melee range of them. The Captain leads the Pirates in hurling threats and promises of a watery grave. The target must make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target marks **1d4+1** Stress. On a success, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Pirate Raiders
adversaries.desc: Seafaring scoundrels moving in a ravaging pack.
adversaries.motives: Gang up, plunder, raid

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Raiders have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.text: When the Raiders mark 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Pirate Tough
adversaries.desc: A thickly muscled and tattooed pirate with melon-sized fists.
adversaries.motives: Plunder, raid, smash, terrorize

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.text: When the Tough marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Clear the Decks
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, **mark a Stress** to move into Melee range of the target, dealing **3d4** physical damage and knocking the target back to Close range.

adversaries.name: Red Ooze
adversaries.desc: A moving mound of translucent flaming red slime.
adversaries.motives: Camouflage, consume and multiply, ignite, start fires

features.name: Creeping Fire
features.text: The Ooze can only move within Very Close range as their normal movement. They light any flammable object they touch on fire.

features.name: Ignite
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes **1d8** magic damage and is _Ignited_ until they're extinguished with a successful Finesse Roll (14). While _Ignited_, the target takes **1d4** magic damage when they make an action roll.

features.name: Split
features.text: When the Ooze has 3 or more HP marked, you can **spend a Fear** to split them into two Tiny Red Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

adversaries.name: Rotted Zombie
adversaries.desc: A decaying corpse ambling toward their prey.
adversaries.motives: Eat flesh, hunger, maul, surround

features.name: Minion (3)
features.text: The Zombie is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Zombie, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Rotted Zombies within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.minionNote:
Minion._** _A decaying corpse ambling toward their prey._
Minion (3) - Passive:_** The Zombie is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Zombie, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Royal Advisor
adversaries.desc: A high-ranking courtier with the ear of the local nobility.
adversaries.motives: Curry favor, manufacture evidence, scheme

features.name: Devastating Retort
features.text: A PC who rolls less than 17 on an action roll targeting the Advisor must mark a Stress.

features.name: Bend Ears
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to influence an NPC within Melee range with whispered words. That target's opinion on one matter shifts toward the Advisor's preference unless it is in direct opposition to the target's motives.

features.name: Scapegoat
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to convince a crowd or notable individual that one person or group is responsible for some problem facing the target. The target becomes hostile to the scapegoat until convinced of their innocence with a successful Presence Roll (17).

adversaries.name: Secret-Keeper
adversaries.desc: A clandestine leader with a direct channel to the Fallen Gods.
adversaries.motives: Amass great power, plot, take command

features.name: Seize Your Moment
features.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to spotlight **1d4** allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Our Master's Will
features.text: When you spotlight an ally within Far range, **mark a Stress** to gain a Fear.

features.name: Summoning Ritual - Reaction: Countdown (6)
features.text: When the Secret-Keeper is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When they mark HP, tick down this countdown by the number of HP marked. When it triggers, summon a Minor Demon who appears at Close range.

features.name: Fallen Hounds
features.text: Once per scene, when the Secret-Keeper marks 2 or more HP, you can **mark a Stress** to summon a Demonic Hound Pack, which appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

adversaries.name: Sellsword
adversaries.desc: An armed mercenary testing their luck.
adversaries.motives: Charge, lacerate, overwhelm, profit

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Sellsword is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Sellsword, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Sellswords within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 3 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.minionNote:
Minion._** _An armed mercenary testing their luck._
Minion (4) - Passive:_** The Sellsword is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Sellsword, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 3 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Shambling Zombie
adversaries.desc: An animated corpse that moves shakily, driven only by hunger.
adversaries.motives: Devour, hungry, mob enemy, shred flesh

features.name: Too Many to Handle
features.text: When the Zombie is within Melee range of a creature and at least one other Zombie is within Close range, all attacks against that creature have advantage.

features.name: Horrifying
features.text: Targets who mark HP from the Zombie's attacks must also mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Shark
adversaries.desc: A large aquatic predator, always on the move.
adversaries.motives: Find the blood, isolate prey, target the weak

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Shark makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Rending Bite
features.text: When the Shark makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Blood in the Water
features.text: When a creature within Close range of the Shark marks HP from another creature's attack, you can **mark a Stress** to immediately spotlight the Shark, moving them into Melee range of the target and making a standard attack.

adversaries.name: Siren
adversaries.desc: A half-fish person with shimmering scales and an irresistible voice.
adversaries.motives: Consume, lure prey, subdue with song

features.name: Captive Audience
features.text: If the Siren makes a standard attack against a target _Entranced_ by their song, the attack deals **2d10+1** damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Enchanting Song
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to sing a song that affects all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become _Entranced_ until they mark 2 Stress. Other Sirens within Close range of the target can **mark a Stress** to each add a +1 bonus to the Difficulty of the reaction roll. While _Entranced_, a target can't act and is _Vulnerable_.

adversaries.name: Skeleton Archer
adversaries.desc: A fragile skeleton with a shortbow and arrows.
adversaries.motives: Perforate distracted targets, play dead, steal skin

features.name: Opportunist
features.text: When two or more adversaries are within Very Close range of a creature, all damage the Archer deals to that creature is doubled.

features.name: Deadly Shot
features.text: Make an attack against a _Vulnerable_ target within Far range. On a success, **mark a Stress** to deal **3d4+8** physical damage.

adversaries.name: Skeleton Dredge
adversaries.desc: A clattering pile of bones.
adversaries.motives: Fall apart, overwhelm, play dead, steal skin

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Dredge is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Dredge, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Dredges within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.minionNote:
Minion._** _A clattering pile of bones._
Minion (4) - Passive:_** The Dredge is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Dredge, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Skeleton Knight
adversaries.desc: A large armored skeleton with a huge blade.
adversaries.motives: Cut down the living, steal skin, wreak havoc

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Knight makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Cut to the Bone
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take **1d8+2** physical damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Dig Two Graves
features.text: When the Knight is defeated, they make an attack against a target within Very Close range (prioritizing the creature who killed them). On a success, the target takes **1d4+8** physical damage and loses **1d4** Hope.

adversaries.name: Skeleton Warrior
adversaries.desc: A dirt-covered skeleton armed with a rusted blade.
adversaries.motives: Feign death, gang up, steal skin

features.name: Only Bones
features.text: The Warrior is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Won't Stay Dead
features.text: When the Warrior is defeated, you can spotlight them and roll a **d6**. On a result of 6, if there are other adversaries on the battlefield, the Warrior re-forms with no marked HP.

adversaries.name: Spectral Archer
adversaries.desc: A ghostly fighter with an ethereal bow, unable to move on while their charge is vulnerable.
adversaries.motives: Move through solid objects, stay out of the fray, rehash old battles

features.name: Ghost
features.text: The Archer has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Pick Your Target
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack within Far range against a PC who is within Very Close range of at least two other PCs. On a success, the target takes **2d8+12** physical damage.

adversaries.name: Spectral Captain
adversaries.desc: A ghostly commander leading their troops beyond death.
adversaries.motives: Move through solid objects, rally troops, rehash old battles

features.name: Ghost
features.text: The Captain has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Unending Battle
features.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to return up to **1d4+1** defeated Spectral allies to the battle at the points where they first appeared (with no marked HP or Stress).

features.name: Hold Fast
features.text: When the Captain's Spectral allies are forced to make a reaction roll, you can **mark a Stress** to give those allies a +2 bonus to the roll.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Spectral Guardian
adversaries.desc: A ghostly fighter with spears and swords, anchored by duty.
adversaries.motives: Move through solid objects, protect treasure, rehash old battles

features.name: Ghost
features.text: The Guardian has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Grave Blade
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal **2d10+6** physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Spellblade
adversaries.desc: A mercenary combining swordplay and magic to deadly effect.
adversaries.motives: Blast, command, endure

features.name: Arcane Steel
features.text: Damage dealt by the Spellblade's standard attack is considered both physical and magic.

features.name: Suppressing Blast
features.text: **Mark a Stress** and target a group within Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **1d8+2** magic damage. You gain a Fear for each target who marked HP from this attack.

features.name: Move as a Unit
features.text: **Spend 2 Fear** to spotlight up to five allies within Far range.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Spellblade makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Spy
adversaries.desc: A skilled espionage agent with a knack for being in the right place to overhear secrets.
adversaries.motives: Cut and run, disguise appearance, eavesdrop

features.name: Gathering Secrets
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to describe how the Spy knows a secret about a PC in the scene.

features.name: Fly on the Wall
features.text: When a PC or group is discussing something sensitive, you can **mark a Stress** to reveal that the Spy is present in the scene, observing them. If the Spy escapes the scene to report their findings, you gain **1d4** Fear.

adversaries.name: Stag Knight
adversaries.desc: A knight with huge, majestic antlers wearing armor made of dangerous thorns.
adversaries.motives: Isolate, maneuver, protect the forest, weed the unwelcome

features.name: From Above
features.text: When the Knight succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal **3d12+3** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Blade of the Forest
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take physical damage equal to **3d4** + the target's Major threshold.

features.name: Thorny Armor
features.text: When the Knight takes damage from an attack within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to deal **1d10+5** physical damage to the attacker.

adversaries.name: Stonewraith
adversaries.desc: A prowling hunter, like a slinking mountain lion, with a slate-gray stone body.
adversaries.motives: Defend territory, isolate prey, stalk

features.name: Stonestrider
features.text: The Stonewraith can move through stone and earth as easily as air. While within stone or earth, they are _Hidden_ and immune to all damage.

features.name: Rocky Ambush
features.text: While _Hidden_, **mark a Stress** to leap into Melee range with a target within Very Close range. The target must succeed on an Agility or Instinct Reaction Roll (15) or take **2d8** physical damage and become temporarily _Restrained_.

features.name: Avalanche Roar
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to roar while within a cave and cause a cave-in. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (14) or take **2d10** physical damage. The rubble can be cleared with a Progress Countdown (8).

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Stonewraith makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Swarm of Rats
adversaries.desc: A skittering mass of ordinary rodents moving as one like a ravenous wave.
adversaries.motives: Consume, obscure, swarm

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.text: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

features.name: In Your Face
features.text: All targets within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks against targets other than the Swarm.

adversaries.name: Sylvan Soldier
adversaries.desc: A faerie warrior adorned in armor made of leaves and bark.
adversaries.motives: Ambush, hide, overwhelm, protect, trail

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.text: If the Soldier makes a standard attack and another Sylvan Soldier is within Melee range of the target, deal **1d8+5** physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Forest Control
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to pull down a tree within Close range. A creature hit by the tree must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (15) or take **1d10** physical damage.

features.name: Blend In
features.text: When the Soldier makes a successful attack, you can **mark a Stress** to become _Hidden_ until the Soldier's next attack or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll (14) to find them.

adversaries.name: Tangle Bramble Swarm
adversaries.desc: A cluster of animate, blood-drinking tumbleweeds, each the size of a large gourd.
adversaries.motives: Digest, entangle, immobilize

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.text: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4+2** physical damage instead.

features.name: Crush
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to deal **2d6+8** direct physical damage to a target with 3 or more bramble tokens.

features.name: Encumber
features.text: When the Swarm succeeds on an attack, give the target a bramble token. If a target has any bramble tokens, they are _Restrained_. If a target has 3 or more bramble tokens, they are also _Vulnerable_. All bramble tokens can be removed by succeeding on a Finesse Roll (12 + the number of bramble tokens) or dealing Major or greater damage to the Swarm. If bramble tokens are removed from a target using a Finesse Roll, a number of Tangle Bramble Minions spawn within Melee range equal to the number of tokens removed.

adversaries.name: Tangle Bramble
adversaries.desc: An animate, blood-drinking tumbleweed.
adversaries.motives: Combine, drain, entangle

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Bramble is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Tangle Bramble, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Tangle Brambles within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Drain and Multiply
features.text: When an attack from the Bramble causes a target to mark HP and there are three or more Tangle Bramble Minions within Close range, you can combine the Minions into a Tangle Bramble Swarm Horde. The Horde's HP is equal to the number of Minions combined.
